evidence_scope: offline exact-model metadata, shared hardware/price inventory, and one read-only Nebius platform-catalog query; no endpoint timing or provider mutation

exact_geometry.attention_pattern: five sliding-window layers then one full-attention layer, repeated ten times

hardware_priors.interpretation: The 5376=42x128, 21504=168x128, and 262144=2048x128 dimensions are tile friendly on both SM90 parts. Tiny decode M is instead exposed to weight streaming and launch/scheduler underfill. The 62.55 GB weights exceed the common 50 MB L2 by about 1251x, so L2 cannot retain them between decode tokens. Hardware peaks are priors, not endpoint-throughput evidence.

memory_mapping_decimal_gb.capacity_discontinuity: Raw weights plus prompt KV permit the prescribed primary c16 ladder on H100 before runtime overhead, but not sixteen simultaneous 10K prompts (19.82 GB KV exceeds its 17.45 GB post-weight headroom). H200 has 78.45 GB post-weight headroom and admits either case before runtime overhead. This is a capacity/headroom hypothesis, not a throughput claim.

endpoint_gain_bounds.mixed_model: speedup = 1 / ((1 - f_hbm) + f_hbm / 1.4328358209), where f_hbm is the matched H100 endpoint-time fraction that faster HBM can actually reduce
endpoint_gain_bounds.falsifier: If matched H100 telemetry bounds recoverable decode-HBM time below 45.84% of primary endpoint time, or shows compute/SM saturation or scheduler/launch limitation at the saturation point, the H200 production route is closed. A bandwidth ratio alone cannot admit it.

economics.formula: H200 is cheaper per completed token only if throughput_h200 / throughput_h100 exceeds rate_h200 / rate_h100 before any unmatched overhead; matched non-GPU overhead cancels only when it is actually matched.
economics.rate_sensitivity_interpretation: The pure-HBM upper bound clears the base and reference hurdles but cannot clear the 1.44 adverse-rate hurdle; a current matched quote is required before any production claim. Disk, setup, failures, orchestration, queueing, and idle headroom must be measured and included after the matched run.

admission_rule: Hold the direct H200 packet until the H100 owner is terminal and inventory is verified empty. Admit one H200 stock-only session only if H100 uses the same identities and its conservative telemetry-derived recoverable-HBM endpoint fraction is at least 0.4583554377, or it demonstrates a concrete capacity/replica discontinuity that changes completed-work economics. Close if the fraction is below that bound, compute/SM or scheduler/launch dominates, H200 placement fails its read-only availability check at execution time, or the matched H200 stock result does not exceed the then-current matched rate hurdle.
